items.q: What is the standard formula for calculating the serum anion gap from routine electrolyte measurements, and what is its normal reference range?
items.exp: The serum anion gap reflects unmeasured plasma anions (predominantly albumin): [Na+] - ([Cl-] + [HCO3-]), with a normal range of 8 to 12 mEq/L.
r: Correct. The serum anion gap reflects unmeasured plasma anions (predominantly albumin): [Na+] - ([Cl-] + [HCO3-]), with a normal range of 8 to 12 mEq/L.

Incorrect. [Na+] - [Cl-]; normal range 30 to 40 mEq/L does not explain the primary biochemical mechanism described.
Incorrect. ([Cl-] + [HCO3-]) - [Na+]; normal range 0 to 4 mEq/L does not explain the primary biochemical mechanism described.
